author: Goswami Tulsidas
edition: Gita Press, Gorakhpur (Shri Hanuman Chalisa, booklets 695 and 2121), orthography normalised
iastNote: IAST is written as the Chalisa is sung, with the short a dropped at word ends and where singers drop it. A full scholarly IAST is kept in iastScholarly.

awadhi: श्रीगुरु चरन सरोज रज निज मनु मुकुरु सुधारि ।
बरनउँ रघुबर बिमल जसु जो दायकु फल चारि ॥
iast: śrīguru caran saroj raj nij manu mukuru sudhāri
baranauṁ raghubar bimal jasu jo dāyaku phal cāri
iastScholarly: śrīguru carana saroja raja nija manu mukuru sudhāri
baranauṁ raghubara bimala jasu jo dāyaku phala cāri

meaning.en: With the dust of my guru's lotus feet I polish the mirror of my mind. Then I sing the spotless glory of Rama, best of the Raghus, which gives all four fruits of life: dharma, wealth, fulfilment and freedom.
meaning.hi: गुरु के चरण-कमलों की धूल से अपने मन का दर्पण साफ़ करके मैं श्रीराम का निर्मल यश गाता हूँ, जो धर्म, अर्थ, काम और मोक्ष, चारों फल देता है।

units.quick: "śrīguru caran saroj raj nij manu mukuru sudhāri" is Doha 1 of the Hanuman Chalisa, which Tulsidas wrote in Awadhi. It means: With the dust of my guru's lotus feet I polish the mirror of my mind. Then I sing the spotless glory of Rama, best of the Raghus, which gives all four fruits of life: dharma, wealth, fulfilment and freedom.

ramayana.en: Tulsidas opens the Ayodhya Kand of his Ramcharitmanas with this same couplet, word for word, as the story turns to the plan to crown Rama.

refs.label: Ramcharitmanas, Ayodhya Kand 2.1, doha 1
refs.text: श्री गुरु चरन सरोज रज निज मनु मुकुरु सुधारि। बरनउँ रघुबर बिमल जसु जो दायकु फल चारि॥

variants: Rambhadracharya's Mahaviri prints निज मन मुकुर ... जस ... दायक, without the final u. The u endings are Awadhi and are what the Gita Press prints.

awadhi: बल बुधि बिद्या देहु मोहिं हरहु कलेस बिकार ॥
iast: bal budhi bidyā dehu mohiṁ harahu kales bikār
iastScholarly: bala budhi bidyā dehu mohiṃ harahu kalesa bikāra

meaning.en: Knowing myself to be short of understanding, I call to mind Hanuman, son of the Wind. Give me strength, understanding and knowledge, and take away my troubles and my faults.
meaning.hi: खुद को बुद्धिहीन जानकर मैं पवनपुत्र हनुमान जी को याद करता हूँ। मुझे बल, बुद्धि और विद्या दीजिए, और मेरे क्लेश और मन के दोष दूर कीजिए।

units.quick: "buddhihīn tanu jānike sumirauṁ pavan-kumār" is Doha 2 of the Hanuman Chalisa, which Tulsidas wrote in Awadhi. It means: Knowing myself to be short of understanding, I call to mind Hanuman, son of the Wind. Give me strength, understanding and knowledge, and take away my troubles and my faults.
variants: Many people sing बल बुद्धि बिद्या. The Gita Press prints बुधि, the Awadhi form, which keeps the metre. Some editions print कलेश for कलेस.

meaning.en: Victory to Hanuman, ocean of wisdom and virtue. Victory to the lord of the vanaras, whose glory lights up the three worlds.
meaning.hi: ज्ञान और गुणों के सागर हनुमान जी की जय हो। तीनों लोकों में उजाला करने वाले वानरराज की जय हो।

units.quick: "jay hanumān jñān gun sāgar" is Chaupai 1 of the Hanuman Chalisa, which Tulsidas wrote in Awadhi. It means: Victory to Hanuman, ocean of wisdom and virtue. Victory to the lord of the vanaras, whose glory lights up the three worlds.

ramayana.en: The Sundar Kand of the Manas opens with a Sanskrit verse to Hanuman that calls him first among the wise and a storehouse of every virtue.

refs.label: Ramcharitmanas, Sundar Kand 5.1, shloka 3
refs.text: अतुलितबलधामं हेमशैलाभदेहं दनुजवनकृशानुं ज्ञानिनामग्रगण्यम् । सकलगुणनिधानं वानराणामधीशं रघुपतिप्रियभक्तं वातजातं नमामि॥

variants: Rambhadracharya's Mahaviri prints गुण for गुन. The sound and sense are the same.

meaning.en: You are Rama's messenger, the home of strength beyond measure. You are known as Anjani's son and as the son of the Wind.
meaning.hi: आप श्रीराम के दूत हैं और अपार बल के धाम हैं। आपको अंजनीपुत्र और पवनपुत्र के नाम से जाना जाता है।

units.quick: "rām dūt atulit bal dhāmā" is Chaupai 2 of the Hanuman Chalisa, which Tulsidas wrote in Awadhi. It means: You are Rama's messenger, the home of strength beyond measure. You are known as Anjani's son and as the son of the Wind.

ramayana.en: In the Valmiki Ramayana, Jambavan reminds Hanuman of his birth: his mother Anjana was the wife of Kesari, and the Wind god was his father. The Manas Sundar Kand calls him the home of matchless strength.

refs.label: Valmiki Ramayana, Kishkindha Kanda 4.66.8
refs.text: अप्सराऽप्सरसां श्रेष्ठा विख्याता पुञ्जिकस्थला। अञ्जनेति परिख्याता पत्नी केसरिणो हरेः॥

refs.label: Valmiki Ramayana, Kishkindha Kanda 4.66.24
refs.text: स त्वं केसरिणः पुत्रः क्षेत्रजो भीमविक्रमः॥

refs.label: Ramcharitmanas, Sundar Kand 5.1, shloka 3
refs.text: अतुलितबलधामं हेमशैलाभदेहं दनुजवनकृशानुं ज्ञानिनामग्रगण्यम् । सकलगुणनिधानं वानराणामधीशं रघुपतिप्रियभक्तं वातजातं नमामि॥

meaning.en: Great hero, valiant, with a body as strong as the thunderbolt, you clear away bad thinking and stay beside good sense.
meaning.hi: आप महावीर हैं, पराक्रमी हैं, आपका शरीर वज्र जैसा है। आप बुरी सोच दूर करते हैं और अच्छी सोच के साथी हैं।

units.quick: "mahābīr bikram bajraṅgī" is Chaupai 3 of the Hanuman Chalisa, which Tulsidas wrote in Awadhi. It means: Great hero, valiant, with a body as strong as the thunderbolt, you clear away bad thinking and stay beside good sense. Read it slowly, one half at a time, and say the Awadhi aloud.

meaning.en: Your colour is gold and your dress is fine. Rings shine in your ears and your hair is curled.
meaning.hi: आपका रंग सोने जैसा है और वेश सुंदर है। कानों में कुंडल हैं और बाल घुँघराले हैं।

units.quick: "kañcan baran birāj subesā" is Chaupai 4 of the Hanuman Chalisa, which Tulsidas wrote in Awadhi. It means: Your colour is gold and your dress is fine. Rings shine in your ears and your hair is curled. Read it slowly, one half at a time, and say the Awadhi aloud.

ramayana.en: The Sundar Kand opening verse describes his body shining like a golden mountain, and in the Ashoka grove he shows Sita a body like a mountain of gold.

refs.label: Ramcharitmanas, Sundar Kand 5.1, shloka 3
refs.text: अतुलितबलधामं हेमशैलाभदेहं दनुजवनकृशानुं ज्ञानिनामग्रगण्यम् । सकलगुणनिधानं वानराणामधीशं रघुपतिप्रियभक्तं वातजातं नमामि॥

refs.label: Ramcharitmanas, Sundar Kand 5.14, chaupai 4
refs.text: कनक भूधराकार सरीरा। समर भयंकर अतिबल बीरा॥

words.gloss: thunderbolt, often read as his mace

meaning.en: In your hands shine the thunderbolt and the flag. A sacred thread of munja grass sits on your shoulder.
meaning.hi: आपके हाथों में वज्र और ध्वजा शोभा देते हैं, और कंधे पर मूँज का जनेऊ सजा है।

units.quick: "hāth bajra au dhvajā birājai" is Chaupai 5 of the Hanuman Chalisa, which Tulsidas wrote in Awadhi. It means: In your hands shine the thunderbolt and the flag. A sacred thread of munja grass sits on your shoulder. Read it slowly, one half at a time, and say the Awadhi aloud.
variants: Rambhadracharya's Mahaviri reads अरु for औ and छाजै for साजै. The sense does not change.

meaning.en: You come from Shiva and are the son of Kesari. Your radiance and might are vast, and the whole world bows to you.
meaning.hi: आप शंकर के अंश और केसरी के पुत्र हैं। आपका तेज और प्रताप महान है, सारा जगत आपको प्रणाम करता है।

units.quick: "saṅkar suvan kesarīnandan" is Chaupai 6 of the Hanuman Chalisa, which Tulsidas wrote in Awadhi. It means: You come from Shiva and are the son of Kesari. Your radiance and might are vast, and the whole world bows to you. Valmiki has Jambavan tell Hanuman that he is the son of Kesari and, by birth, the son of the Wind.

ramayana.en: Valmiki has Jambavan tell Hanuman that he is the son of Kesari and, by birth, the son of the Wind.

refs.label: Valmiki Ramayana, Kishkindha Kanda 4.66.24
refs.text: स त्वं केसरिणः पुत्रः क्षेत्रजो भीमविक्रमः॥

variants: Rambhadracharya, in his Mahaviri commentary, reads शंकर स्वयं केसरीनंदन, "Shiva himself, as Kesari's son", since tradition holds Hanuman to be a form of Shiva. The Gita Press prints संकर सुवन.

meaning.en: Learned, full of virtue and very wise, you are always eager to do Rama's work.
meaning.hi: आप विद्वान हैं, गुणी हैं, बहुत चतुर हैं, और श्रीराम का काम करने को हमेशा तत्पर रहते हैं।

units.quick: "bidyāvān gunī ati cātur" is Chaupai 7 of the Hanuman Chalisa, which Tulsidas wrote in Awadhi. It means: Learned, full of virtue and very wise, you are always eager to do Rama's work. Over the ocean, the mountain Mainaka rises and offers him rest. Hanuman touches it, bows, and says there is no rest for him until Rama's work is done.

ramayana.en: Over the ocean, the mountain Mainaka rises and offers him rest. Hanuman touches it, bows, and says there is no rest for him until Rama's work is done.

refs.label: Ramcharitmanas, Sundar Kand 5.1, doha 1
refs.text: हनूमान तेहि परसा कर पुनि कीन्ह प्रनाम। राम काजु कीन्हें बिनु मोहि कहाँ बिश्राम॥

meaning.en: You love to hear the Lord's story. Rama, Lakshmana and Sita live in your heart.
meaning.hi: प्रभु की कथा सुनने में आपको आनंद आता है। श्रीराम, लक्ष्मण और सीता आपके मन में बसते हैं।

units.quick: "prabhu caritra sunibe ko rasiyā" is Chaupai 8 of the Hanuman Chalisa, which Tulsidas wrote in Awadhi. It means: You love to hear the Lord's story. Rama, Lakshmana and Sita live in your heart. Read it slowly, one half at a time, and say the Awadhi aloud.

ramayana.en: In the Valmiki Ramayana's last book, Hanuman asks Rama that his love stay fixed on him, and that he may live on earth as long as Rama's story is told.

refs.label: Valmiki Ramayana, Uttara Kanda 7.40.8
refs.text: यावद्रामकथा वीर चरिष्यति महीतले। तावच्छरीरे वत्स्यन्तु प्राणा मम न संशयः॥

variants: Some Gita Press printings spell लखन as लषन, the older spelling, read the same way.
Some read the line the other way round: you live in the hearts of Rama, Lakshmana and Sita.

meaning.en: Taking a tiny form, you showed yourself to Sita. Taking a fearsome form, you set Lanka on fire.
meaning.hi: आपने छोटा रूप लेकर सीता जी को दर्शन दिए, और विकराल रूप लेकर लंका जला दी।

units.quick: "sūkṣma rūp dhari siyahiṁ dikhāvā" is Chaupai 9 of the Hanuman Chalisa, which Tulsidas wrote in Awadhi. It means: Taking a tiny form, you showed yourself to Sita. Taking a fearsome form, you set Lanka on fire. Read it slowly, one half at a time, and say the Awadhi aloud.

ramayana.en: He enters Lanka in a form as small as a mosquito, later comes down from the tree to stand near Sita, and when his tail is set alight he grows huge yet light and leaps from roof to roof as the city burns.

refs.label: Ramcharitmanas, Sundar Kand 5.3, chaupai 7
refs.text: मसक समान रूप कपि धरी। लंकहि चलेउ सुमिरि नरहरी॥

refs.label: Ramcharitmanas, Sundar Kand 5.11, chaupai 10
refs.text: तब हनुमंत निकट चलि गयऊ। फिरि बैठीं मन बिसमय भयऊ॥

refs.label: Ramcharitmanas, Sundar Kand 5.24, chaupai 1
refs.text: देह बिसाल परम हरुआई। मंदिर तें मंदिर चढ़ धाई॥

meaning.en: Taking a terrible form, you destroyed the asuras and carried Rama's work through.
meaning.hi: आपने भयंकर रूप लेकर राक्षसों का संहार किया और श्रीरामचंद्र के काम पूरे किए।

units.quick: "bhīm rūp dhari asur saṁhāre" is Chaupai 10 of the Hanuman Chalisa, which Tulsidas wrote in Awadhi. It means: Taking a terrible form, you destroyed the asuras and carried Rama's work through. In the Ashoka grove Ravana sends his son Akshay Kumar with an army. Hanuman pulls up a tree, strikes him down and roars.

ramayana.en: In the Ashoka grove Ravana sends his son Akshay Kumar with an army. Hanuman pulls up a tree, strikes him down and roars.

refs.label: Ramcharitmanas, Sundar Kand 5.16, chaupai 4
refs.text: पुनि पठयउ तेहिं अच्छकुमारा। चला संग लै सुभट अपारा॥

meaning.en: You brought the sanjivani herb and revived Lakshmana. Rama, hero of the Raghus, held you to his heart with joy.
meaning.hi: आपने संजीवनी लाकर लक्ष्मण जी के प्राण बचाए, और श्रीराम ने खुश होकर आपको गले लगा लिया।

units.quick: "lāy sajīvan lakhan jiyāye" is Chaupai 11 of the Hanuman Chalisa, which Tulsidas wrote in Awadhi. It means: You brought the sanjivani herb and revived Lakshmana. Rama, hero of the Raghus, held you to his heart with joy. Read it slowly, one half at a time, and say the Awadhi aloud.

ramayana.en: When Lakshmana falls in battle, the physician Sushena names the herb on the mountain and Hanuman goes for it. When he returns, the Manas says Rama embraced Hanuman with joy, the words this line echoes.

refs.label: Ramcharitmanas, Lanka Kand 6.55, doha 1
refs.text: राम पदारबिंद सिर नायउ आइ सुषेन। कहा नाम गिरि औषधी जाहु पवनसुत लेन॥

refs.label: Ramcharitmanas, Lanka Kand 6.60, chaupai 10
refs.text: हरषि राम भेंटेउ हनुमाना। अति कृतग्य प्रभु परम सुजाना॥

variants: Some editions read संजीवन or सँजीवनि for सजीवन.

awadhi: तुम मम प्रिय भरतहि सम भाई ॥
iast: tum mam priya bharatahi sam bhāī
iastScholarly: tuma mama priya bharatahi sama bhāī

meaning.en: Rama, lord of the Raghus, praised you greatly: "You are as dear to me as my brother Bharata."
meaning.hi: श्रीराम ने आपकी बहुत प्रशंसा की और कहा, तुम मुझे भरत जैसे प्यारे भाई हो।

units.quick: "raghupati kīnhī bahut baṛāī" is Chaupai 12 of the Hanuman Chalisa, which Tulsidas wrote in Awadhi. It means: Rama, lord of the Raghus, praised you greatly: "You are as dear to me as my brother Bharata." At their first meeting in the Manas, Rama tells Hanuman he is twice as dear to him as Lakshmana.

ramayana.en: At their first meeting in the Manas, Rama tells Hanuman he is twice as dear to him as Lakshmana.

refs.label: Ramcharitmanas, Kishkindha Kand 4.4, chaupai 4
refs.text: सुनु कपि जियँ मानसि जनि ऊना। तैं मम प्रिय लछिमन ते दूना॥

variants: Some editions print भरतहिं.

words.gloss: mouths, here Shesha, the thousand-headed serpent

meaning.en: "May the thousand-mouthed Shesha sing your glory," said Rama, lord of Shri, and he held you close.
meaning.hi: हज़ार मुखों वाले शेषनाग तुम्हारा यश गाएँ, यह कहकर श्रीराम ने आपको गले लगा लिया।

units.quick: "sahas badan tumharo jas gāvaiṁ" is Chaupai 13 of the Hanuman Chalisa, which Tulsidas wrote in Awadhi. It means: "May the thousand-mouthed Shesha sing your glory," said Rama, lord of Shri, and he held you close. When Hanuman returns with news of Sita, Valmiki has Rama say that an embrace is all he can give him in return.

ramayana.en: When Hanuman returns with news of Sita, Valmiki has Rama say that an embrace is all he can give him in return.

refs.label: Valmiki Ramayana, Yuddha Kanda 6.1.13
refs.text: एष सर्वस्वभूतस्तु परिष्वङ्गो हनूमत । मया कालमिमं प्राप्य दत्तस्तस्य महात्मनः॥

meaning.en: Sanaka and his brothers, Brahma and the gods, the great sages, Narada and Saraswati, with Shesha, lord of serpents,
meaning.hi: सनक आदि ऋषि, ब्रह्मा आदि देवता, बड़े-बड़े मुनि, नारद, सरस्वती और शेषनाग भी,

units.quick: "sanakādik brahmādi munīsā" is Chaupai 14 of the Hanuman Chalisa, which Tulsidas wrote in Awadhi. It means: Sanaka and his brothers, Brahma and the gods, the great sages, Narada and Saraswati, with Shesha, lord of serpents, Read it slowly, one half at a time, and say the Awadhi aloud.

awadhi: कबि कोबिद कहि सके कहाँ ते ॥
iast: kabi kobid kahi sake kahāṁ te
iastScholarly: kabi kobida kahi sake kahāṁ te

meaning.en: Yama, Kubera and the guardians of the directions cannot tell your glory in full. How could poets and scholars?
meaning.hi: यम, कुबेर और दिशाओं के रक्षक भी आपका यश पूरा नहीं कह पाते, तो कवि और विद्वान कैसे कहें।

units.quick: "jam kuber digpāl jahāṁ te" is Chaupai 15 of the Hanuman Chalisa, which Tulsidas wrote in Awadhi. It means: Yama, Kubera and the guardians of the directions cannot tell your glory in full. How could poets and scholars? Read it slowly, one half at a time, and say the Awadhi aloud.
variants: Some editions, including Rambhadracharya's, read सकें.

meaning.en: You did Sugriva a great kindness. You brought him to Rama and gave him back his kingdom.
meaning.hi: आपने सुग्रीव पर उपकार किया। उन्हें श्रीराम से मिलाया और राजपद दिलाया।

units.quick: "tum upkār sugrīvahiṁ kīnhā" is Chaupai 16 of the Hanuman Chalisa, which Tulsidas wrote in Awadhi. It means: You did Sugriva a great kindness. You brought him to Rama and gave him back his kingdom. Hanuman tells each side the other's story, and Rama and Sugriva seal their friendship with fire as witness.

ramayana.en: Hanuman tells each side the other's story, and Rama and Sugriva seal their friendship with fire as witness.

refs.label: Ramcharitmanas, Kishkindha Kand 4.5, doha 1
refs.text: तब हनुमंत उभय दिसि की सब कथा सुनाइ। पावक साखी देइ करि जोरी प्रीति दृढ़ाइ॥

meaning.en: Vibhishana took your counsel and became king of Lanka, as the whole world knows.
meaning.hi: विभीषण ने आपकी सलाह मानी और लंका के राजा बने, यह सारा संसार जानता है।

units.quick: "tumharo mantra bibhīṣan mānā" is Chaupai 17 of the Hanuman Chalisa, which Tulsidas wrote in Awadhi. It means: Vibhishana took your counsel and became king of Lanka, as the whole world knows. In Lanka, Hanuman meets Vibhishana and tells him how Rama always loves those who serve him.

ramayana.en: In Lanka, Hanuman meets Vibhishana and tells him how Rama always loves those who serve him.

refs.label: Ramcharitmanas, Sundar Kand 5.6, chaupai 3
refs.text: सुनहु बिभीषन प्रभु कै रीती। करहिं सदा सेवक पर प्रीति॥

words.gloss: yojanas, an old measure of distance

meaning.en: The sun stood thousands upon thousands of yojanas away, and you swallowed it, taking it for a sweet fruit.
meaning.hi: हज़ारों योजन दूर के सूरज को आपने मीठा फल समझकर निगल लिया।

units.quick: "jug sahasra jojan par bhānū" is Chaupai 18 of the Hanuman Chalisa, which Tulsidas wrote in Awadhi. It means: The sun stood thousands upon thousands of yojanas away, and you swallowed it, taking it for a sweet fruit. Read it slowly, one half at a time, and say the Awadhi aloud.

ramayana.en: Valmiki has Jambavan recall it: as a child Hanuman saw the rising sun, took it for a fruit and leapt into the sky to seize it.

refs.label: Valmiki Ramayana, Kishkindha Kanda 4.66.16
refs.text: अभ्युत्थितं ततः सूर्यं बालो दृष्ट्वा महावने। फलं चेति जिघृक्षुस्त्वमुत्पत्याभ्युत्पतो दिवम्॥

variants: Many printings show सहस्त्र, a common misspelling of सहस्र.

meaning.en: With the Lord's ring in your mouth you leapt over the ocean. That is no wonder.
meaning.hi: प्रभु की अँगूठी मुँह में रखकर आपने समुद्र लाँघ लिया, इसमें कोई अचरज नहीं।

units.quick: "prabhu mudrikā meli mukh māhīṁ" is Chaupai 19 of the Hanuman Chalisa, which Tulsidas wrote in Awadhi. It means: With the Lord's ring in your mouth you leapt over the ocean. That is no wonder. Before the search parties leave, Rama touches Hanuman's head and gives him his ring. At the ocean, Hanuman goes like Rama's unfailing arrow.

ramayana.en: Before the search parties leave, Rama touches Hanuman's head and gives him his ring. At the ocean, Hanuman goes like Rama's unfailing arrow.

refs.label: Ramcharitmanas, Kishkindha Kand 4.24, chaupai 5
refs.text: परसा सीस सरोरुह पानी। करमुद्रिका दीन्हि जन जानी॥

refs.label: Ramcharitmanas, Sundar Kand 5.1, chaupai 4
refs.text: जिमि अमोघ रघुपति कर बाना। एही भाँति चलेउ हनुमाना॥

meaning.en: However many hard tasks there are in the world, your grace makes every one of them easy.
meaning.hi: संसार के जितने भी कठिन काम हैं, आपकी कृपा से सब आसान हो जाते हैं।

units.quick: "durgam kāj jagat ke jete" is Chaupai 20 of the Hanuman Chalisa, which Tulsidas wrote in Awadhi. It means: However many hard tasks there are in the world, your grace makes every one of them easy. Read it slowly, one half at a time, and say the Awadhi aloud.

meaning.en: You guard Rama's door. No one enters without your leave.
meaning.hi: आप श्रीराम के द्वार के रखवाले हैं। आपकी आज्ञा के बिना कोई भीतर नहीं जा सकता।

units.quick: "rām duāre tum rakhvāre" is Chaupai 21 of the Hanuman Chalisa, which Tulsidas wrote in Awadhi. It means: You guard Rama's door. No one enters without your leave. Read it slowly, one half at a time, and say the Awadhi aloud.

awadhi: तुम रच्छक काहू को डर ना ॥
iast: tum racchak kāhū ko ḍar nā
iastScholarly: tuma racchaka kāhū ko ḍara nā

meaning.en: Whoever takes refuge in you finds every happiness. With you as protector, there is nothing to fear.
meaning.hi: जो आपकी शरण में आता है, उसे सब सुख मिलते हैं। आप रक्षक हों तो किसी का डर नहीं।

units.quick: "sab sukh lahai tumhārī sarnā" is Chaupai 22 of the Hanuman Chalisa, which Tulsidas wrote in Awadhi. It means: Whoever takes refuge in you finds every happiness. With you as protector, there is nothing to fear. Read it slowly, one half at a time, and say the Awadhi aloud.
variants: Rambhadracharya's Mahaviri reads लहहिं. Some printings run डर ना together as डरना; read it as two words, "no fear".

meaning.en: Only you can hold your own power. At your roar the three worlds tremble.
meaning.hi: अपने तेज को आप ही सँभाल सकते हैं। आपकी एक हुंकार से तीनों लोक काँप उठते हैं।

units.quick: "āpan tej samhāro āpai" is Chaupai 23 of the Hanuman Chalisa, which Tulsidas wrote in Awadhi. It means: Only you can hold your own power. At your roar the three worlds tremble. Read it slowly, one half at a time, and say the Awadhi aloud.

meaning.en: Ghosts and evil spirits do not come near when someone speaks the name of the great hero.
meaning.hi: जब कोई महावीर का नाम लेता है, तो भूत-पिशाच पास नहीं आते।

units.quick: "bhūt pisāc nikaṭ nahiṁ āvai" is Chaupai 24 of the Hanuman Chalisa, which Tulsidas wrote in Awadhi. It means: Ghosts and evil spirits do not come near when someone speaks the name of the great hero. Read it slowly, one half at a time, and say the Awadhi aloud.

meaning.en: Illness is destroyed and every pain taken away for one who repeats the name of brave Hanuman without a break.
meaning.hi: वीर हनुमान का नाम लगातार जपने से रोग मिटते हैं और सारी पीड़ा दूर होती है।

units.quick: "nāsai rog harai sab pīrā" is Chaupai 25 of the Hanuman Chalisa, which Tulsidas wrote in Awadhi. It means: Illness is destroyed and every pain taken away for one who repeats the name of brave Hanuman without a break. Read it slowly, one half at a time, and say the Awadhi aloud.

awadhi: मन क्रम बचन ध्यान जो लावै ॥
iast: man kram bacan dhyān jo lāvai
iastScholarly: mana krama bacana dhyāna jo lāvai

meaning.en: Hanuman frees from trouble whoever keeps him in mind, in thought, in deed and in word.
meaning.hi: जो मन, कर्म और वचन से हनुमान जी का ध्यान करता है, हनुमान जी उसे संकट से छुड़ाते हैं।

units.quick: "saṅkaṭ teṁ hanumān chuṛāvai" is Chaupai 26 of the Hanuman Chalisa, which Tulsidas wrote in Awadhi. It means: Hanuman frees from trouble whoever keeps him in mind, in thought, in deed and in word. Read it slowly, one half at a time, and say the Awadhi aloud.

awadhi: तिन के काज सकल तुम साजा ॥
iast: tin ke kāj sakal tum sājā
iastScholarly: tina ke kāja sakala tuma sājā

meaning.en: Rama, the ascetic king, is above all, and you carried out every one of his tasks.
meaning.hi: तपस्वी राजा श्रीराम सबसे ऊपर हैं, और उनके सारे काम आपने ही पूरे किए।

units.quick: "sab par rām tapasvī rājā" is Chaupai 27 of the Hanuman Chalisa, which Tulsidas wrote in Awadhi. It means: Rama, the ascetic king, is above all, and you carried out every one of his tasks. Read it slowly, one half at a time, and say the Awadhi aloud.
variants: Rambhadracharya, in his Mahaviri commentary, reads सब पर राम राय सिरताजा, "Rama, crown of kings, is above all".

meaning.en: Whoever brings you any other wish receives it, and with it the boundless fruit of life.
meaning.hi: जो कोई भी आपके पास कोई और इच्छा लेकर आता है, वह उसे पाता है, और साथ में जीवन का असीम फल भी।

units.quick: "aur manorath jo koi lāvai" is Chaupai 28 of the Hanuman Chalisa, which Tulsidas wrote in Awadhi. It means: Whoever brings you any other wish receives it, and with it the boundless fruit of life. Read it slowly, one half at a time, and say the Awadhi aloud.
variants: Rambhadracharya's Mahaviri reads तासु for सोइ. Some printings have कोई for कोइ.

meaning.en: Your glory runs through all four ages, and its fame lights up the world.
meaning.hi: चारों युगों में आपका प्रताप है। आपकी कीर्ति से सारा जगत उजला है।

units.quick: "cāroṁ jug partāp tumhārā" is Chaupai 29 of the Hanuman Chalisa, which Tulsidas wrote in Awadhi. It means: Your glory runs through all four ages, and its fame lights up the world. Read it slowly, one half at a time, and say the Awadhi aloud.
variants: Rambhadracharya's Mahaviri reads चारिउ for चारों.

meaning.en: You protect the good and the saints. You destroy the asuras, and Rama holds you dear.
meaning.hi: आप साधु-संतों के रखवाले हैं, राक्षसों का नाश करने वाले हैं, और श्रीराम के दुलारे हैं।

units.quick: "sādhu sant ke tum rakhvāre" is Chaupai 30 of the Hanuman Chalisa, which Tulsidas wrote in Awadhi. It means: You protect the good and the saints. You destroy the asuras, and Rama holds you dear. Read it slowly, one half at a time, and say the Awadhi aloud.

awadhi: अष्ट सिद्धि नौ निधि के दाता ।
iast: aṣṭ siddhi nau nidhi ke dātā
iastScholarly: aṣṭa siddhi nau nidhi ke dātā

meaning.en: You can give the eight siddhis and the nine treasures. Mother Janaki gave you this boon.
meaning.hi: आप आठ सिद्धियाँ और नौ निधियाँ देने वाले हैं। माता जानकी ने आपको यह वरदान दिया है।

units.quick: "aṣṭ siddhi nau nidhi ke dātā" is Chaupai 31 of the Hanuman Chalisa, which Tulsidas wrote in Awadhi. It means: You can give the eight siddhis and the nine treasures. Mother Janaki gave you this boon. Read it slowly, one half at a time, and say the Awadhi aloud.

ramayana.en: In the Ashoka grove Sita blesses Hanuman: may he be ageless, deathless and a storehouse of virtue. The boon of siddhis and treasures is the Chalisa's own telling.

refs.label: Ramcharitmanas, Sundar Kand 5.15, chaupai 2
refs.text: अजर अमर गुननिधि सुत होहू। करहुँ बहुत रघुनायक छोहू॥

variants: Some editions, including Rambhadracharya's, read नव निधि and दीन्ह.

words.gloss: of Rama, lord of the Raghus

meaning.en: You hold the elixir of devotion to Rama, and you remain forever the servant of the lord of the Raghus.
meaning.hi: राम-भक्ति का रसायन आपके पास है, और आप सदा श्रीराम के सेवक बने रहते हैं।

units.quick: "rām rasāyan tumhare pāsā" is Chaupai 32 of the Hanuman Chalisa, which Tulsidas wrote in Awadhi. It means: You hold the elixir of devotion to Rama, and you remain forever the servant of the lord of the Raghus. Read it slowly, one half at a time, and say the Awadhi aloud.
variants: Rambhadracharya, in his Mahaviri commentary, reads सादर हौ रघुपति के दासा, "you are Raghupati's servant, with reverence".

meaning.en: By singing of you a person reaches Rama and leaves behind the sorrows of birth after birth.
meaning.hi: आपका भजन करके मनुष्य श्रीराम को पाता है और जन्म-जन्म के दुख भूल जाता है।

units.quick: "tumhare bhajan rām ko pāvai" is Chaupai 33 of the Hanuman Chalisa, which Tulsidas wrote in Awadhi. It means: By singing of you a person reaches Rama and leaves behind the sorrows of birth after birth. Read it slowly, one half at a time, and say the Awadhi aloud.
variants: Some printings read भावै: "singing of you pleases Rama".

meaning.en: At the end that person goes to Rama's abode, and wherever they are born again they are known as a devotee of Hari.
meaning.hi: अंत समय में वह श्रीराम के धाम जाता है, और जहाँ भी जन्म ले, हरिभक्त कहलाता है।

units.quick: "ant kāl raghubar pur jāī" is Chaupai 34 of the Hanuman Chalisa, which Tulsidas wrote in Awadhi. It means: At the end that person goes to Rama's abode, and wherever they are born again they are known as a devotee of Hari.
variants: Rambhadracharya's Mahaviri prints हरि-भगत.

meaning.en: Even one who keeps no other deity in mind finds every happiness by serving Hanuman.
meaning.hi: किसी और देवता को मन में न भी रखे, तो भी हनुमान जी की सेवा से सब सुख मिलते हैं।

units.quick: "aur devtā citt na dharaī" is Chaupai 35 of the Hanuman Chalisa, which Tulsidas wrote in Awadhi. It means: Even one who keeps no other deity in mind finds every happiness by serving Hanuman. Read it slowly, one half at a time, and say the Awadhi aloud.

meaning.en: Troubles are cut away and all pain ends for whoever remembers Hanuman, the strong hero.
meaning.hi: जो बलवीर हनुमान जी को याद करता है, उसके संकट कट जाते हैं और सारी पीड़ा मिट जाती है।

units.quick: "saṅkaṭ kaṭai miṭai sab pīrā" is Chaupai 36 of the Hanuman Chalisa, which Tulsidas wrote in Awadhi. It means: Troubles are cut away and all pain ends for whoever remembers Hanuman, the strong hero. Read it slowly, one half at a time, and say the Awadhi aloud.

awadhi: कृपा करहु गुरु देव की नाईं ॥
iast: kṛpā karahu guru dev kī nāīṁ
iastScholarly: kṛpā karahu guru deva kī nāīṃ

meaning.en: Victory, victory, victory to you, Hanuman, my master. Be kind to me as a guru is kind.
meaning.hi: हे स्वामी हनुमान जी, आपकी जय हो, जय हो, जय हो। गुरु की तरह मुझ पर कृपा कीजिए।

units.quick: "jai jai jai hanumān gosāīṁ" is Chaupai 37 of the Hanuman Chalisa, which Tulsidas wrote in Awadhi. It means: Victory, victory, victory to you, Hanuman, my master. Be kind to me as a guru is kind. Read it slowly, one half at a time, and say the Awadhi aloud.
variants: Many sing जय जय जय. Rambhadracharya's Mahaviri prints गुरुदेव as one word.

awadhi: जो सत बार पाठ कर कोई ।
iast: jo sat bār pāṭh kar koī
iastScholarly: jo sata bāra pāṭha kara koī

meaning.en: Whoever recites this a hundred times is freed from bondage and finds great joy.
meaning.hi: जो कोई इसका सौ बार पाठ करे, वह बंधनों से छूट जाता है और उसे बड़ा सुख मिलता है।

units.quick: "jo sat bār pāṭh kar koī" is Chaupai 38 of the Hanuman Chalisa, which Tulsidas wrote in Awadhi. It means: Whoever recites this a hundred times is freed from bondage and finds great joy. Read it slowly, one half at a time, and say the Awadhi aloud.
variants: Rambhadracharya's Mahaviri reads जो शत बार ... छुटहिं. Some popular printings read यह सत बार.

meaning.en: Whoever reads this Hanuman Chalisa gains fulfilment. Shiva, lord of Gauri, is witness.
meaning.hi: जो यह हनुमान चालीसा पढ़ता है, उसे सिद्धि मिलती है। इसके साक्षी स्वयं गौरीपति शिव हैं।

units.quick: "jo yah paṛhai hanumān calīsā" is Chaupai 39 of the Hanuman Chalisa, which Tulsidas wrote in Awadhi. It means: Whoever reads this Hanuman Chalisa gains fulfilment. Shiva, lord of Gauri, is witness. Read it slowly, one half at a time, and say the Awadhi aloud.
variants: The Gita Press and Rambhadracharya both print चलीसा, which keeps the metre. Most families sing चालीसा.

meaning.en: Tulsidas is forever Hari's servant. Lord, make your home in my heart.
meaning.hi: तुलसीदास सदा हरि के सेवक हैं। हे नाथ, मेरे हृदय में अपना डेरा बनाइए।

units.quick: "tulsīdās sadā hari cerā" is Chaupai 40 of the Hanuman Chalisa, which Tulsidas wrote in Awadhi. It means: Tulsidas is forever Hari's servant. Lord, make your home in my heart. Read it slowly, one half at a time, and say the Awadhi aloud.

awadhi: पवनतनय संकट हरन मंगल मूरति रूप ।
राम लखन सीता सहित हृदय बसहु सुर भूप ॥
iast: pavantanay saṅkaṭ haran maṅgal mūrati rūp
rām lakhan sītā sahit hṛday basahu sur bhūp
iastScholarly: pavanatanaya saṃkaṭa harana maṃgala mūrati rūpa
rāma lakhana sītā sahita hṛdaya basahu sura bhūpa

meaning.en: Son of the Wind, remover of trouble, whose very form is blessing: king among the gods, live in my heart with Rama, Lakshmana and Sita.
meaning.hi: हे पवनपुत्र, संकट हरने वाले, मंगल की मूर्ति, हे देवताओं के राजा, आप श्रीराम, लक्ष्मण और सीता के साथ मेरे हृदय में बसिए।

units.quick: "pavantanay saṅkaṭ haran maṅgal mūrati rūp" is closing doha of the Hanuman Chalisa, which Tulsidas wrote in Awadhi. It means: Son of the Wind, remover of trouble, whose very form is blessing: king among the gods, live in my heart with Rama, Lakshmana and Sita.
variants: Some Gita Press printings spell लखन as लषन, the older spelling, read the same way.
